input_contract.note: Proposed first integration envelope; endpoint remains unavailable.

implemented_slice: Learned 8x subsampler, all 24 Conformer layers, LSTM predictor and autonomous TDT/UTF-8 selection on the shared-profile ISA; waveform frontend remains offline oracle

qualification.text_output_format: Device-selected UTF-8 scatter/gather bytes plus lengths; host output I/O only

blockers.detail: Device PCM conversion, preemphasis, STFT, mel, log and masked normalization are missing.
The complete learned 8x subsampler is shared-profile ISA-qualified; its device waveform-frontend and physical runtime handoff are not integrated.
All 24 whole-context Conformer layers and one-slot residency are shared-profile ISA-qualified with real checkpoint weights; physical program/wait loading and execution remain unverified.
INT6 embedding, both LSTM layers and the Transformers cache policy are shared-profile ISA-qualified; physical state/cache acceptance remains gated.
Joint head, token/duration selection, EOS and zero-duration/watchdog behavior pass real-checkpoint ISA tests; physical runtime integration remains unverified.
Device-selected UTF-8 segments and byte lengths match the pinned text policy; physical output I/O/API integration remains unqualified.
Learned encoder and TDT/text path pass real-speech CPU/ISA comparisons; device waveform parity, larger-context coverage, physical transcript and WER acceptance remain missing.
No real audio-to-transcript FPGA run; a coordinated hardware window is required.
